renderer: Three.js r180. Fixed garage view with one car per capture. Assets include each complete hero vehicle.

notes: the gate did not start the challenge after 30 s (mode free)

terrainMaterialBuffers.method: Actual Low terrain streamer with production tile data. Counts include resident mesh material attributes at both morph endpoints. The world sample hashes cover vertex positions and triangle indices. Separate 800 x 450 terrain-only WebGL frames use identical cameras, sunlight and fog. Image differences are absolute sRGB 8-bit channel code values.

drivingCadence.method: Same recorded tick-indexed steering, brakes and throttle in seeded, wet four-car Ashvale Sprint. Full vehicle snapshots sampled every simulation second at three clock update rates.

everyPhysicsTick.method: Identical recorded throttle, brake and steer commands. Every serialized four-car simulation snapshot was hashed at 120 Hz for 110 seconds. Presentation cadence used integer 1/720-second intervals.

quarryCarriageway.method: Normal travel run-up, real tyres and steering, slide controller, traffic enabled. Finish time starts at the entry gate.

controlledDrift.method: Normal travel run-up, then a steering flick, throttle and countersteer under the standard simulation and drift scoring. The route driver takes over after the manoeuvre.

portIlseReplay.encoding: 800 × 450 WebGL picture with a 50-pixel telemetry band, H.264, 192 distinct captured frames.
portIlseReplay.method: Two four-second excerpts from the wet six-entrant race. Production player rig and snapshot motion, local road and nearby building meshes under fixed review lighting.

wheelMotion.method: Four production contact records per SC-7 snapshot in the two recorded shots. Differences are evaluated within each shot, excluding the edit.

roadBuffers.method: All indexed sections under the road-chunk groups in the production Solvane RoadMeshes. Byte counts cover unique vertex attributes and index buffers. Hashes cover each named attribute expanded in the same triangle and batch order, with signed zero canonicalized.

inputComponents.coverage: Real launch-board and Festival HUD components, keyboard, standard emulated controller, retry, map, photo mode, race feedback and screen sizes.

steps.name: Returned to the paddock and released the Festival HUD

firstAttempt.outcome: The browser process closed while entering Festival after the quality change.

nightAttempt.outcome: The first storefront capture exceeded the local software-rendering deadline.

localLongRace.outcome: Chromium closed during the race to the results screen.

highPresetLocal.outcome: Both renderer processes closed before a High-preset capture.

productionSessionFirstDraw.outcome: The first frame was submitted. The compositor screenshot exceeded 90 seconds. A separate readback attempt lost its renderer during loading.

delayedReflectionFrames.method: Production reflection scheduler and Three.js cube cameras, with WebGL draw submissions recorded instead of rasterised.

localHighHarbourFrame.capture: Chromium compositor including the regular game HUD. Default arrival with no fast-travel override.
